property_summary: For any caller, when sending exactly 10 ether to C's fallback at strictly increasing timestamps, the reference contract only forwards its entire balance back to the caller exactly when block.number % 15 == 0 (so address(c).balance == 0 after the call iff block.number % 15 == 0); the mutant inverts the conditional so there exist block numbers where this balance observation differs.
change_summary: Change the conditional so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0 instead of == 0, altering when funds are sent and thus observable state.
